# Water Capital Wire

> A free daily read on the business of water for managers, investors and operators: capital, companies, technology, infrastructure and water security, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a lead story traced through the water cycle (source, treatment, use, reuse, discharge), briefs across the water economy, weekly spotlights on a company, a leader, a supplier, an innovation and an investor, a capital desk of deals and firms, a water atlas on stress, demand, infrastructure, emerging sectors and security, a watchlist of water equities, a project calculator and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Ninth Circuit says California owed water rights holders a hearing before its 2021 drought cutoffs](https://watercapitalwire.com/): November 26, 2026. A unanimous Ninth Circuit panel ruled that California's 2021 drought curtailments on Deer Creek and Mill Creek targeted a few identifiable rights holders, so they were owed a meaningful hearing first.
- [Capital: Sciens Water buys Roberts Filter Group, a filtration maker founded in 1889, as its third platform](https://watercapitalwire.com/#money)
- [Regulation: UN General Assembly makes the water conference a fixture, every three years from 2031](https://watercapitalwire.com/#world)
- [Technology: Cheyenne's utility says data centers took about 2% of its water sales in 2025](https://watercapitalwire.com/#cheyenne)
- [Utilities: UK says water supply no longer stalls any planned Greater Cambridge development](https://watercapitalwire.com/#cambridge)
